scope: Read-only review of published actual observations, planned splits, frozen parameters, grid validation, independent metrics and reproduction code. No new hardware I/O, no refit, no new dependencies.
conclusion: The new fixed-k3 model supersedes the old failed Brown5 model for this wrist installation. Published full-frame numerical invertibility checks pass; proceed to action/data/policy adaptation rather than re-run the calibration cycle. Absolute metric task accuracy and unseen near-field/edge accuracy remain unverified.

calibration_binding.direction: T_flange_camera maps RGB optical coordinates into flange_link, metres
calibration_binding.board: Q12-290-20, 11x8; 0 at lower right near model text; +x along long edge to left, +y along short edge upward

numeric_inverse.caveat: Numerical function checks do not establish full-frame empirical imaging accuracy. Same-K undistorted output has 5,744 ideal pixels sampling outside received source; do not silently change VLA preprocessing.

physical_accuracy_limits: Nominal 20 mm square still used; previous coarse 197/200 mm discrepancy has no new precise scale measurement in these files.
Training corners stop at y=354.0897; bottom roughly 26% is numerically valid but lacks checkerboard support.
Training target origin depth 0.617–0.737 m does not certify closer gripper-object geometry.
Independent translation P95 5.3541 mm is slightly above prior suggested 5 mm engineering target, not a strict automatic pass.
Nine true post-freeze poses improve independence; low PnP residual still not physical absolute accuracy.
artifact_notes: frozen.json, fix_k3.json:model and wrist_rgb_calibration.json K/D/X equal exactly.
All accepted final rows are timestamped 17.5029–80.8622 seconds after frozen timestamp; all 11 planned final rows occur after freeze.
51 accepted rows have 88 corners, matching serial, real G and receive timestamps; 35/7/9 split matches preallocated plan.
reproduce.py fits K,D and Park X only on rows split=train and in_fit_or_score=true; final views are not fit inputs.
recommended_minimum_next: Bind current received RGB + K/D/X to serial/frame/installation and calibration version; retain raw RGB for policy unless preprocessing is deliberately retrained.
Move to real action-label/continuous tracking and public-data supervision readiness; no need for routine full recollection.

Before actual grasping, verify task-space visibility and contact clearance with current device state; use task outcome/physical reference to evaluate rather than treating calibration residual as success rate.
For precision tasks or camera/arm mount changes, add targeted physical validation or recalibration appropriate to changed conditions.
publication_note: Compact review evidence. Local retrieval paths may refer to analysis-only source material that was not published; see README.md for the exact published subset. No complete source episode or training dataset is included.
